additional_info.subject: 0403511 - Vehicle in EV suspended mode CRM:00902000089
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
We noticed that the vehicle number -
23532 , which is
charging with charger ALN 102,  Connector 1 is not taking any power.
Session began at (Session began at 11:40 PM CET)
The vehicle was plugged in with 40% SOC and is now stuck at 46% SOC.
From the logs we can see that the power import (i.e power taken the vehicle reduced to 0kw gradaully from initial 77Kw).
We would recommmend
Reconnecting the vehicle to the same connector
If issue still persist, connect the vehicle with the alternative connector.
Above mentioned steps would also help us further into our investigation.
Thank you for your kind patience and support., while we get back to you with the resolution.
Regards
Siemens Depot360 NOC Team.

Technician onsite tried replugging the vehicle with the same connector 2 twice,  from DF graph we could see the power delivery at 77 KW .
The same vehicle 23532 when connected with ALN 102 connector 2, began importing power at 169KW which rose to 200KW and is charging normal.
Charging session id in Depot369 :
397475524

Hi Team ,
We have been noticing an issue with certain charging sessions, where
The charging session would normally begin with 70 -60 Kw power delivery and then gradually drop till 0Kw and end up in ‘Suspended EV’ mode.
The vehicle start SOC could be as low as 19% - 40% so SOC is also not the reason for drop in the import power.
The same vehicle when plugged with different connector would charger normally (around 160 - 200Kw depending on the SOC).
Here is a screen shot from current charging session on ALN 102, Connector 2, which began around 11:40 AM CET, 2/2/2025, which  continued 1:23 PM CET 2/2/2025
Vehicle number 23532
We need your help investigating the reason behind this issue.
We are attaching a file containing details of past such Charging sessions.
Form the SCB logs, could we also check the vehicle FW of Solaris vehicles which were used during such charging session ?
Low Energy Delivered Cases for past 14 days.docx

additional_info.subject: Handover to ES
additional_info.body:
a) Problem Description: Connector 2 power for
MP / SD 170004183
derating during a charging session.
b) Suspected Root Cause: Connector 2 issue / EV issue
c) Action Performed: During the charging session dt. 02/02/25 → 10:40 UTC time, we see that a charging session with transaction id 665903339 started to derate after a few minutes of charging (~10:47 UTC). The charging started at 77kW and went down to 0kW. We see that the actual deration of values started after we receive a power converter error log :
2025-02-02T10:56:01.947583+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/5664ccf39e58[709]: PLC-Error-Flag 'PowerConverter[1]' changed from false - ('2102313PAVKXP9002342SA022010000000FW:DC903PF903H100,F:1') to false - ('
2102313PAVKXP9002342SA022000000000FW:DC903PF903H100
,F:1')
Our observation is that the power converter id is not identical in the same log (the id in bold does not match the id above).
We tried checking EcoG logs (attached), however we only have them available from 11:00 onwards, where kW values were already dropped to 0kW.
We also checked the mac of the vehicle (
00.16.81.03.6c.8e) and we see that this vehicle chargers without deration at CP2 and on other chargers in this project, we also saw that when CP1 was occupied and the vehicle was on CP2, the deration did not happen.
We also see that for CP2 this deration of kW is not constant as multiple different charging sessions are seen successful.
d) Charger SW Version: 6.0.3
e) Reason for Handover: Detailed log analysis / troubleshooting
f) Fault history: NA
EV Make and Model: ESolaris
Attachment: EcoG logs
PLEASE note : This case came to NOC from Depot360 team and hence we do not have Business flow change access. Once after log analysis done, please transfer this case to NOC so that we will transfer it back to Depot360 with the relavant troubleshooting steps.
